How It Works

Four Steps to Keys in Hand

A simple process built around your timeline, your goals, and your peace of mind.

STEP 01

Get Pre-Qualified

Gretza reviews your finances and matches you with the right loan before you tour a single home.

Know your budget
STEP 02

Find Your Home

With your budget set, she guides your search across Brevard County: new construction, resale, and off-market.

Shop with confidence
STEP 03

Negotiate & Close

She structures your offer, negotiates for you, and manages the loan, so the closing table holds no surprises.

No surprises

Move In

From first conversation to keys in hand, one call handles everything.

About

Gretza Roman

Licensed Real Estate Agent • Licensed Loan Officer

Gretza holds both a Florida real estate license and a mortgage loan officer license. Few professionals hold both, and she chose that combination on purpose.

For over 15 years she has served buyers, sellers, veterans, retirees, and investors across Brevard County. Her clients come back because one conversation handles everything.
